ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

In compliance of the order dated 11.7.2014, affidavit of Deputy General Manager (Production)
in-charge LAQ, ONGC, state that the proposal for permanent acquisition of the petitioner's land has been uploaded on PM gati shakti Portal (Portal provided for the purpose) on 30.7.2024.

In the affidavit-in-reply filed by the Collector, Ahmedabad it is stated that after uploading of the proposal on 30.7.2024, the proposal in physical form has been received in the office of the competent Dineshbhai Mansukhbhai Donga vs State Of Gujarat on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128368781/
1 authority i.e. Special Land Acquisition Officer (ONGC), on 1.8.2024.

entities.text: Dineshbhai Mansukhbhai Donga vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
However, due to some NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2334/2024 ORDER DATED: 13/08/2024 undefined technical error,
proposal was returned back from the login of the competent authority to the acquiring body.

However that issue has been resolved and the proposal is again received on PM gati shakti Portal, on 9.8.2024, which was submitted on the same day to the revenue department for issuance of Section 10A notification.
2. Taking note of the above, we provide that the entire acquisition process shall be completed within a period of 6 months from today with the making of the award by undertaking the proceedings strictly in accordance to Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
The petition stands disposed of with above directions.
